data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross strengthening of $52.141 million in prior year claims during 2017. This is based on the 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year' line in the claims outstanding reconciliation. While this specific gross claims provision showed strengthening, the narrative in the Chairman's and Underwriter's Reports indicates that the overall loss development activity for the 2015 Year of Account was relatively benign, leading to reserve releases across most years and a favourable run-off for the combined 2014 and prior years. Specific losses of note for prior years included the Tianjin China warehouse explosion, Germanwings Flight 9525, and Fort McMurray Alberta wildfires. The positive movements on closed years of account from 2001 through 2014 also contributed to the overall prior year results.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred in prior underwriting year 52,141

The loss development activity for this year of account has been relatively benign and the result has just surpassed the upper limit of the previously indicated range due to strong pure year performance across all classes and reserve releases across most years.

The combined 2014 and prior years continued to run off favourably across all classes, this has culminated in a result that exceeds our previous official forecast range +8.5% to +13.5% (September 2017).

positive contributions from mature open years of account, being 2015 and 2016, together with the positive movements on the closed years of account (2001 through 2014) that occurred during the calendar year.

data.data_quality_notes: The 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year' from Note 14 (page 18) shows a gross strengthening of $52.141 million. This contradicts narrative statements in the Chairman's and Underwriter's Reports (pages 2, 3, 5) which refer to 'reserve releases across most years' and 'favourable run-off' for prior years of account. The specific line item for gross claims provision movement was prioritized for the 'prior_year_development_gbp_m' and 'direction' fields, while the narrative is included in the 'standardized_narrative' and 'raw_causal_phrases' to reflect the overall context of prior year results.
